title: 歐亞海底公路隧道~Eurasia Tunnel
focus: 雙層道路、海底盾構與斷面系統整合~Double-deck roadway, subsea boring and section integration
summary: 歐亞隧道官方將計畫分為14.6公里走廊及其中5.4公里隧道與連接段，2016年開始服務。本課集中雙層道路圓形隧道：先檢查外水壓與襯砌，再分開樓板受力、通風、行車視覺及撤離；所有斷面尺寸及荷載算例均屬教學假設，不能當成實際設計值。~The operator distinguishes a 14.6 km corridor from its 5.4 km tunnel-and-connection section and records service beginning in 2016. This course focuses on a circular tunnel with a double-deck roadway, linking external pressure and lining to deck loads, ventilation, driver vision and evacuation. All numerical section dimensions and loads are teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 歐亞道路走廊與隧道連接段有不同長度範圍，先固定起訖點再比較壅塞與自由行車時間。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~The road corridor and tunnel connection have different scope lengths; fix endpoints before comparing congested and free-flow travel. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=15.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=15.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為16.72 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=15.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 16.72 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對時間資料是否包括市區引道及入口排隊。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check whether time data include urban approaches and entrance queues. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把隧道內時間宣稱為全走廊旅行時間會誇大效益。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Presenting in-tunnel time as whole-corridor time overstates the benefit. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對時間資料是否包括市區引道及入口排隊。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check whether time data include urban approaches and entrance queues. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 海底盾構段的外壓教材採測壓水頭，研究海面、地層和施工降水條件不一致的情境。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Use piezometric head for the subsea bored section and examine differences among sea level, strata and construction drainage conditions. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=63 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=618.03 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為679.833 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=63 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=618.03 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 679.833 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將孔壓與海潮序列比較，分辨延遲及隔離層。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare pore pressure with tidal histories to identify lag and isolated layers. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 直接以海面深度代替所有水頭會忽略地層連通差異。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Replacing all heads with sea depth ignores differences in connectivity. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：將孔壓與海潮序列比較，分辨延遲及隔離層。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare pore pressure with tidal histories to identify lag and isolated layers. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 有效掘進利用率~Effective boring utilisation
units.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時~Boring utilisation and equipment downtime
units.mechanism: 歐亞海底掘進背景用來分離切削、環片拼裝與維修停時，探討高瞬時效率未必提高日產量。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。~Separate cutting, segment erection and maintenance in subsea boring, testing why high instantaneous performance need not raise daily advance. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.74 m/h；有效利用率=0.28 無因次。D=24vu=11.6928 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.8621 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.74 m/h; utilisation=0.28 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.6928 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.8621 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把扭矩推力與停機原因對齊同一里程。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Align torque, thrust and downtime causes at common chainage. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 拼裝等待被歸為刀具問題會導致錯誤設備調整。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。~Erection queues labelled as cutter problems prompt incorrect machine changes. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.
units.misconception: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。~A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
units.practice: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：把扭矩推力與停機原因對齊同一里程。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Align torque, thrust and downtime causes at common chainage. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 圓形襯砌承受海底外壓，同時受雙層樓板支承反力，教學薄環結果需與局部接觸分開。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~The circular lining carries external pressure and internal deck reactions, requiring membrane estimates to be separated from local contact effects. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.46 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=4.33714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4.77086 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.46 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.33714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4.77086 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較遠離與鄰近樓板支承處的應變和接縫變形。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare strain and joint movement near and away from deck supports. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 均勻壓力模型可能漏掉支承處局部彎矩及裂縫。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~A uniform-pressure model misses local bending and cracking at supports. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較遠離與鄰近樓板支承處的應變和接縫變形。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare strain and joint movement near and away from deck supports. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑~Internal decks and load paths
units.mechanism: 歐亞雙層道路中間樓板是實際行車荷載路徑，教材條帶只示範均載彎矩，另列集中輪載需求。雙層公路的樓板、或隧道內設備隔板，都把局部荷載傳給支承，但兩者功能與設計作用並不相同。簡支條帶可估計均載彎矩，集中輪載、剪力、疲勞與火災降強度必須另驗；幾何空間分層不能取代結構邊界的確認。~The intermediate roadway deck is a traffic-load path; the teaching strip illustrates distributed bending while concentrated wheel loads remain separate. A double-deck road slab and an equipment partition both transfer local loads to supports but serve different functions and design actions. A simply supported strip estimates uniform-load bending. Concentrated wheel loads, shear, fatigue and fire-reduced strength require separate checks; dividing space geometrically does not establish the actual structural restraints.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=28 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。M=qL²/8=45.36 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為54.8856 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: line load=28 kN/m; span=3.6 m. M=qL²/8=45.36 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 54.8856 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對行車面、支承和施工階段，不與設備隔板混用。核對支承位置、施工接縫及荷載分布，將實測撓度與分階段模型比較，分辨整體變形與支承滑移。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check roadway surface, supports and stages without substituting equipment-partition assumptions. Check support positions, construction joints and load distribution; compare measured deflection with staged models to distinguish member bending from support slip. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把樓板當非承重分隔會漏掉交通彎剪和疲勞作用。把隔板誤當行車樓板會使用錯誤荷載，反之漏掉交通集中荷載則低估局部彎剪與疲勞。~Treating the deck as nonstructural separation omits traffic bending, shear and fatigue. Mistaking a partition for a roadway deck applies the wrong actions, while omitting concentrated traffic load underestimates local bending, shear and fatigue.
units.misconception: 只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。~Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
units.practice: 本案「樓板條帶受彎」的交付需回答：核對行車面、支承和施工階段，不與設備隔板混用。交付時明示樓板用途、支承及各施工階段，讓建築淨空、設備配置及結構假設在同一版本中核對。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the deck-strip bending handover must address the following evidence: Check roadway surface, supports and stages without substituting equipment-partition assumptions. State deck function, supports and construction stages at handover so clearance, equipment layout and structural assumptions can be reconciled in one revision.

units.anchor: 止水壓縮餘量~Gasket compression reserve
units.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡~Joint compression and sealing envelope
units.mechanism: 圓孔接頭與變形介面的止水能力需對應不同位移形式，研究平均壓縮合格但局部錯台的情境。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。~Match sealing performance to different displacement modes at ring joints and movement interfaces, including local offsets despite acceptable average compression. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
units.model: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=18 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=12 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為11.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=18 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=12 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 11.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將最不利角點的壓縮和剪移一起送入接頭試驗。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Use compression and shear at the adverse corner in joint tests. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只取平均縫寬會掩蓋局部止水脫離。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。~Mean joint width can conceal local gasket separation. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.
units.misconception: 接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。~An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
units.practice: 本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：將最不利角點的壓縮和剪移一起送入接頭試驗。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Use compression and shear at the adverse corner in joint tests. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 雙層道路的通風支路與樓板隔離相互作用，研究一層門位變化是否改變另一層的風量。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Ventilation branches interact with deck separation; test whether changing doors on one level redistributes air on the other. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=820 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.6 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.852 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為48.2209 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=820 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.6 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.852 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 48.2209 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure pressure and flow on both levels simultaneously and record traffic state. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩層風機額定量相加不能代表各層實際有效換氣。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Summed fan ratings do not establish effective airflow on each level. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Measure pressure and flow on both levels simultaneously and record traffic state. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度~Visual adaptation and pavement luminance
units.mechanism: 雙層道路入口與轉接段的視角不同，歐亞教材區分照度、路面反射及駕駛看到的亮度。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。~Different viewing geometries at entrances and transitions require illuminance, pavement reflection and driver-view luminance to be distinguished. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：照度=96 lx；反射率=0.27 無因次。L=ρE/π=8.25059 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為9.07565 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=96 lx; reflectance=0.27 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=8.25059 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 9.07565 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩層照度相同不保證障礙物對比相同。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。~Equal illuminance on two levels does not ensure equal obstacle contrast. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.
units.misconception: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。~Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
units.practice: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 從雙層道路轉入安全通道時存在垂直及水平移動，教學時間帳要保留找門與下車延遲。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Moving from a double-deck roadway to safety combines vertical and horizontal travel with door-finding and vehicle-exit delay. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=96 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=546 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為591 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=96 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=546 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 591 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只量平面最短線會漏掉樓層轉換和排隊。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~A plan-view shortest line omits level changes and queues. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 道路系統資料需保留樓層與方向，研究相同里程上下層設備被錯配時如何影響維修和告警定位。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Asset records must retain level and direction to prevent upper- and lower-deck equipment at one chainage being confused. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=108 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.7037 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=108 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.7037 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 缺樓層欄位會把修繕隊送到同里程的錯誤位置。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Missing level data sends maintainers to the wrong location at the correct chainage. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Eurasia Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，再獨立計算「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=63 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=618.03 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為679.833 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：初始壓縮=18 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=12 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為11.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate piezometric head and lining pressure, then independently calculate joint compression and sealing envelope. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=63 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=618.03 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 679.833 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=18 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=12 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 11.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2016 年公開記錄：歐亞隧道完成並開始服務。歐亞隧道官方將計畫分為14.6公里走廊及其中5.4公里隧道與連接段，2016年開始服務。本課集中雙層道路圓形隧道：先檢查外水壓與襯砌，再分開樓板受力、通風、行車視覺及撤離；所有斷面尺寸及荷載算例均屬教學假設，不能當成實際設計值。本課把「雙層道路、海底盾構與斷面系統整合」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2016: Eurasia Tunnel is completed and launched for service. The operator distinguishes a 14.6 km corridor from its 5.4 km tunnel-and-connection section and records service beginning in 2016. This course focuses on a circular tunnel with a double-deck roadway, linking external pressure and lining to deck loads, ventilation, driver vision and evacuation. All numerical section dimensions and loads are teaching assumptions. The course treats double-deck roadway, subsea boring and section integration as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 5.4 km tunnel and connection section，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 5.4 km tunnel and connection section; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2016 年事件：歐亞隧道完成並開始服務。~2016 event: Eurasia Tunnel is completed and launched for service.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=15.2 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=15.2 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=15.2 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 15.2 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=618.03 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 618.03 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「樓板條帶受彎」：單位長載重=28 kN/m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=45.36 kN·m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching deck-strip bending: line load=28 kN/m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 45.36 kN·m; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「止水壓縮餘量」：初始壓縮=18 mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=12 mm；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching gasket compression reserve: initial compression=18 mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 12 mm; not measured or accepted project data.
